related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment scope_grant and claims through the authenticated Control bridge

observed_failures.context: The session already had intent-level writable authority for mncs-environment; Control also had an exact owner-approved campaign/repository entry and the request selected one registered main linked checkout. The live Environment implementation rejected the request before recording a scope grant.

source_checkout_context.relationship_before_sync: configured root was a clean ancestor of published main
source_checkout_context.local_action: fast-forwarded the clean, unclaimed configured root to the already-pushed main revision so the running bridge could execute current Environment code

observation.interpretation_limit: The live request succeeded after the configured root checkout was advanced to pushed main. The code-level selection defects are independently covered by regression tests. The bridge component that retained the stale source pointer is not separately instrumented, so this observation does not isolate whether the remaining stale selection was held by the MCP adapter or its Environment source cache.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Owner-approved linked checkout authority can be blocked or lost between scope admission, source selection, and claim pickup
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment scope grants, linked-checkout selection, and Control source resolution
pressure_hypothesis.basis: One authenticated session showed an exact owner-approved scope request rejected because the repository was already in intent-level writable authority. Regression isolation found that owner-authorized linked checkout selection also had to supersede the entry-time repository checkout in both admission validation and subsequent claim acquisition. The configured Environment source checkout was clean but behind the pushed main revision; after advancing it to main, the live scope grant and exact worktree claim succeeded.

user_reported_pattern.report: The user reports repeated branch pickup, merge, and push authorization stalls over roughly two weeks.
user_reported_pattern.measurement_status: user-reported; no cross-session historical count was reconstructed

pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Keep owner approval exact to campaign, repository, and registered checkout; treat the owner-selected checkout as the durable selection through claim acquisition; refresh the Environment source when main advances; preserve publication status and checkout identity in the diagnostic projection.
